## Summary

[Partial] Remove the differential assembly, then install the locking mechanism and adjust preload. [t1916]

## Specifications

- **Shop install cost (per axle)**: $450 [t1916] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Shop labor rate**: ~$75 per hour [t1916] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Shops often offer a free gear swap while the diff is out. [t1916]
- Prices range from $300 to over $800 depending on whether air lines and custom mounts are included. [t1916]
